notes.title: Royal Vermin Demo Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!


We made some changes on our demo, including bugs fixing and adding some cool stuff!


Bug fixes
Fixed an issue where only the first 4 controllers could be used when more than 4 controllers were connected

Added missing translation text

Linux players can actually see their outlines now (they were being shy apparently)

Special rounds were getting a bit too predictable - gave the randomizer a good kick

Improved hit player projection physics

Fixed a bug where players would run indefinitely if the menu was opened while running

Fixed an issue where dashing before being hit could sometimes cancel the hit projection

Fixed an issue where players could get stuck inside the customization container when falling back into it
New Features
Game politely pauses itself when your controller rage-quits on you

Added new splash screen intro sequence

Enhanced camera movement in "Falling Container" special game mode - camera now moves upward

Multiple players dying simultaneously are now both considered winners! Communism in action

Threw in a helpful video for Steam Remote Play (because coordinating 4 people online is hard enough)
Balance Changes
Increased field of view (FOV) for the first race special round

Players and balls can no longer pass through the bottom of the basketball net (house rules!)

Added a tiny grace period at race start so you don't instantly eat dirt
